ai.sum: DEM Party Adıyaman co-chair criticised the continued detention of Selahattin Demirtaş and Figen Yüksekdağ and called for concrete steps.
ai.title_en: DEM Party Adıyaman Co-chair Gönül Şahin: 'Kurdish people now expect concrete steps, not words'

items.title: Selçuk Bayraktar: Gökçeada Özdemir Bayraktar İnsansız Hava Araçları Meslek Yüksekokulunu kuracağız
items.summary: Baykar Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Bayraktar, Gökçeada Özdemir Bayraktar İnsansız Hava Araçları Meslek Yüksekokulunu kuracaklarını belirterek "Kardeşlerimiz hem orada eğitim görecek hem Keşan'da Baykar Uçuş Eğitim ve Test Merkezi'nde eğitim görecek" dedi.

ai.sum: Baykar chairman Selçuk Bayraktar announced plans to establish a drone vocational school on Gökçeada.

items.title: Turkey requires COP31 speakers to pledge compliance with ‘public morality’
items.summary: The requirement has raised concerns over vague restrictions on speech as it differs from the UN rules protecting inclusive participation.

ai.sum: Türkiye requires COP31 speakers to pledge compliance with 'public morality', raising concerns over vague speech restrictions.

items.title: Rüzgar enerjisi sektöründe işletme ve bakım pazarının büyüklüğü 350 milyon dolara ulaştı
items.summary: Türkiye'de karasal rüzgar santrallerinin yıllık işletme ve bakım pazarının uluslararası referans fiyatlar esas alınarak hesaplanan tahmini büyüklüğü yaklaşık 350 milyon dolara ulaştı.

ai.sum: The annual operation and maintenance market for Türkiye's onshore wind farms is estimated at about $350 million.
ai.title_en: Wind energy operation and maintenance market in Türkiye reaches $350 million

items.title: Erdogan wants to discuss ending Russia-Ukraine war with Putin after talks with Zelenskiy
items.summary: Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan said he wanted to speak to his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin to discuss efforts to end the war in Ukraine, after talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy on Saturday. Speaking to reporters on a return flight from South Korea, Erdogan said his foreign minister and other relevant officials were holding talks […]

ai.sum: Erdogan, after talks with Zelenskiy, said he wants to speak with Putin about ending the Russia-Ukraine war and that Turkish officials are holding talks.

items.title: MOL receives US license for preparatory work on buying Russian stake in NIS
items.summary: The statement clarified that this license "does not authorize the completion of the transaction resulting in the divestment of Russian ownership and control in NIS"

ai.sum: The US granted MOL a license for preparatory work on buying Russia's stake in NIS, but not for completing the divestment.

items.title: Türkiye’s defense giant Aselsan develops submarine optronic mast system for maritime surveillance
items.summary: Mercan 100 combines high-performance mid-wave and short-wave infrared cameras with panoramic surveillance and sectoral scanning modes

items.title: Türkiye repays $2.6B to over 420,000 investors as fund liquidations proceed
items.summary: Nearly 180,000 investors recover full net investments, Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek says

items.title: Merkez Bankası rezervleri 158,1 milyar dolar oldu
items.summary: Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankasının (TCMB) toplam rezervleri, 30 Ekim haftasında bir önceki haftaya göre 4 milyar 84 milyon dolar azalarak 158 milyar 107 milyon dolar oldu.

items.title: Turkish parliament adopts 1st article of Türkiye-Pakistan-Saudi Arabia defense agreement bill
items.summary: Lawmakers approve first article of bill on Mecca Joint Defense Agreement signed by 3 countries in August to strengthen collective security, defense cooperation

ai.sum: Turkish parliament approved the first article of the bill ratifying the Mecca defence pact signed by Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in August.

items.title: Turkey to bring Akkuyu NPP into operation in coming weeks — minister
items.summary: According to Alparslan Bayraktar, the works on the plant have entered a phase that entails hundreds of individual tests

ai.sum: Energy minister Alparslan Bayraktar said the Akkuyu nuclear plant, Türkiye's first, will enter operation in coming weeks as hundreds of tests proceed.
